text: ITEM 1 | Roughly 20 almond-like nuts scattered in a loose cluster in the centre-right of a white square plate; each is oval and pointed at one end, tan to golden-brown with a smooth, matte, slightly papery skin and faint lengthwise ridges, about 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide; a few are split or halved showing pale cream interiors; no sauce, oil, or sheen; they are dry, firm, and hold their shape; a few sit on top of others, and no cooking marks such as char or breading are visible | 24
